attempts.rationale: Testing robustness against unstable rankings via trimmed mean.

The trimmed mean performed well, but since the ranking stability (ranking_tau) is very low, I want to test if a weighted approach using inverse error can better leverage the top-performing models while still being robust.

The ranking instability (ranking_tau 0.103) and high trend strength suggest that a simple mean might be too sensitive to individual model errors; I will test the DBA (Dynamic Bass Algorithm) to see if it can better capture the underlying signal through a more structural combination.

The ranking instability (ranking_tau 0.103) and trend-dominated regime suggest that a simple mean might be too sensitive to poor-performing models in a single window. I will test a softmax-weighted approach to see if it provides better error attenuation than the current leader.
Testing a simple unweighted mean as a robust baseline against the unstable ranking.

The ranking stability is low (ranking tau 0.103) and the series is trend-dominated, so I will test a median combination of the full pool to see if it provides better robustness against unstable rankings than the current leader.
Testing if focusing on a smaller subset of models with inverse error weighting improves robustness compared to the full-pool median.
Testing if softmax weighting on a smaller, more focused pool improves robustness against the unstable ranking.
Testing if a robust median combination on a smaller, high-performing pool helps mitigate the instability of model rankings.
Testing trimmed mean on the top-performing pool to see if robustness to outlier models in the small pool helps.
Testing if inverse_error weighting on pool1 provides a better balance than the previous softmax or w5 approaches.
Testing shape-based DBA on the high-performing pool1 to handle the unstable ranking and trend-dominated regime.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9712. Series context: trend strength 0.8613 and seasonal strength 0.3179; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.103); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.285.
